notes.title: Update Notes: Version 3.03 (EA) - Adjustments to Wilderness Hero Structure
notes.content:
Update Notes: Version 3.03 (EA) - Adjustments to Wilderness Hero Structure in Game
Note: It is recommended to completely delete all old save files before playing this version.

Characters will now be generated and stored based on continents, rather than being uniformly generated across the entire world as before.

As a result, save file locations have also changed and are not compatible with previous versions. Therefore, players will generally need to start a new game.

From now on, issues such as missing characters on the map or empty areas should occur much less frequently.

The number of characters has also been significantly increased again.

Moving forward, it will be much easier for me to address bugs related to faction wars and dungeon issues.

PS: This is absolutely the final adjustment to the data structure. In short, the frequent bugs related to faction wars and dungeons were primarily due to an inefficient save structure for wilderness heroes. Unlike most games where NPCs are randomly generated temporarily, the majority of NPCs in this game will eventually be integrated into a cause-and-effect reincarnation system, meaning they must be preserved. This requires a uniquely designed data structure. I hope this update truly resolves the issue, allowing future development to focus on enhancing gameplay.

notes.content:

PS. This Chinese New Year’s Eve marks a milestone, Moving forward, we’ll expand AI control to behaviors, scenarios, and even mystic realms, where AI will challenge players with dynamic strategies.

Why This Matters:
From the start, this game was designed to prioritize emergent gameplay and randomness over scripted missions or storylines. With AI advancements and reduced costs, we’re thrilled to take this crucial step toward letting AI shape limitless experiences.

Happy Chinese New Year! 🎉

notes.title: Version Description: 1.03EA the nine tailed celestial fox update, for playtest
notes.content:
Version Description: 1.03EA

I.Major Improvements:

Added support for English language.
Can initiate wars in areas where exploration reaches 100%, capturing them to gain additional resources.
Can steal and rob from NPCs that haven't joined players.
Significantly increased dialogues, including tutorial prompts and some main storyline.
Fixed numerous bugs.


II. For Convenient Mod Adjustments:
The game is currently in the Early Access stage and is not very polished. It is not recommended for players to create mods at this stage, but it is possible to modify certain skill, item, and dialogue parameters.

1. Editable Data Path
Some of the game's editable data can be found at the following path:
Game Root Directory\The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox_Data\StreamingAssets\Languages\
Inside this directory, you will find language folders such as:
\cn for Chinese
\en for English
Within these folders, you can find most of the game data, including martial arts, elixirs, materials, bosses, etc.

2. Editing Files
These files are originally edited in Excel and then exported as CSV documents. You can open these CSV documents with a text editor, make changes, and save them. The game will automatically read and use these modified data.
Notes:
a.Both CSV and TXT files must be in UTF-8 format to avoid garbled text or errors.
b.If you only modify the English data, only the English version of the game will reflect those changes.
c.Approximately 20% of martial arts and elixirs have special skills that are written separately and cannot be edited via CSV files.
d.The XLSX files in the document folders can be ignored. The system only reads CSV and TXT files. XLSX files are kept for easier viewing.

3. Translating Content
Translating all the text under the Languages directory will cover about 99% of the game's content.

Explanation of Possible Translation Issues
Our game includes place names, monsters, plants, deities, meridians, and acupoints from the Chinese classic "Shan Hai Jing" (Classic of Mountains and Seas) from over 2000 years ago. Consequently, about 30% of the characters are rare or obscure. With the help of AI, we have managed to release an English version, but it is not perfectly accurate. Many parts had to be transliterated into pinyin. However, this may actually be a relief for global players since many of these characters are not easily understood by Chinese players either, and without pinyin, they cannot even be read.

III. Short-term Improvement Plans:
The overall development direction of the game is a sandbox experience with aimless exploration. We will continue to enhance the randomness and fun of the maps and dungeons.
Introducing a martial arts tournament system, including tournaments for marriage proposals. Players can watch and bet, or participate themselves. Gradually implementing special skills for skill cards during battles.
Allowing players to collect outfits. Community feedback will be prioritized for review and modifications.
